text:
kristen: RC rc-2026-03-21-03 built and smoke checks passed. artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/infra:rc-2026-03-21-03. Requesting sign-off for promotion in the midnight UTC change window (00:30 UTC). Deploy details below.

deploy-bot: [build 2109876543] Containers pushed, image digest sha256:abc123def456. Integration smoke: PASS. Canary tests: PASS. Flaky-test-run: 2 failures (known flaky, tracked in #qa-flaky).

ashwin: Quick checks — what's the pinned model/runtime? Any config override compared to last RC?

kristen: We'll pin runtime to `runtime:v2.7.1` and model to `redwood-instruct-1.2` (same as last RC). Pin command I'm going to use:
```
redwood-cli pin --service infra --image gcr.io/redwood/infra:rc-2026-03-21-03 --runtime runtime:v2.7.1 --model redwood-instruct-1.2
```
Canary plan: 10% traffic for 20m, health checks every 30s, then 50% for 10m, then 100% if stable. Rollback plan: immediate traffic shift to `infra@stable` and redeploy previous image.

elaine: @oncall-sre FYI — make sure the autoscaler alarm is unmuted. Also confirm log retention for 2h post-deploy. If p95 latency rises > 250ms for 5m, abort canary.

mike: QA: regression test that failed earlier was fixed in the RC (cherry-pick 0f2d3e). I ran the smoke locally. Can we add a quick `curl` smoke step after canary promotion?

jonah: :thumbsup: +1 from infra. Suggest we add an additional latency check on the first 5m window: compare service p50/p95 to baseline via `telemetry.compare`.

release-coordinator: Release notes link: https://docs.internal/releases/rc-2026-03-21-03. Reminder to include migration note for config flag `enable_new_cache=true`. Change window approved for 00:30–02:00 UTC. Approvals needed: @elaine, @ashwin, @mike

ashwin: I approve. Will run promote and keep a rollback ready. Assigning myself as executor. ETA start 00:31 UTC.

elaine: Approved from SRE side — alarms unmuted and runbook checked. If anything looks off I'll trigger immediate rollback.

mike: QA sign-off. I'll run post-canary smoke at 00:55 UTC.

release-coordinator: Tagging release ticket RED-4821 and adding `release:rc-2026-03-21-03` label.

kristen: Thanks all. @deploy-bot schedule promotion at 00:31 UTC. :shipit: 

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by kristen for 00:31 UTC. Will post progress here.

ashwin: Running promotion now — pinning and shifting 10% canary.
```
deploy-tool promote --rc rc-2026-03-21-03 --to prod --canary 10 --pin runtime:v2.7.1,model:redwood-instruct-1.2
```

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Step: pin image -> routing update -> gradual traffic shift.

deploy-bot: Canary 10% applied. Health checks passing (5m).

mike: Post-canary smoke: all critical paths (login, inference, billing write) OK from my run.

deploy-bot: Canary 50% applied. Health checks passing (10m). p95=180ms, error-rate=0.03%.

jonah: Looks healthy to me. Continue to 100%.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% complete. Old image labeled `infra@stable` retained for quick rollback. Release ticket RED-4821 updated.

kristen: Promo ✅. Thanks everyone. Closing thread; postmortem only if rollback triggered. :tada:
